metadata.description: Portal access skills for every CLI agent - terminal sharing, native web UIs, and session sharing.

plugins.name: oh-my-portal
plugins.description: Universal CLI agent access: reach any terminal-based agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OMP, opencode, ...) from a phone over a terminal or the agent's native web UI, published behind a Portal tunnel.

plugins.name: oh-my-omp
plugins.description: OMP-specific: share a live Oh My Pi session with a phone through OMP collab, via the hosted relay or a self-hosted relay behind a Portal tunnel.
